items.expected: Keep the full TTA derivative graphs and define charge/state and molecular reference consistently. Distinguish orbital eigenvalues, ionization energetics, work functions and actual transferred charge. For an interface claim, document the chosen nanotube/coverage/geometry and why its model scope is applicable. Respect differing compositions and loadings.

Quantify relevant electronic differences with raw molecular or interface evidence, explicit reference conventions and applicability to the source system. Assess the claim being tested rather than merely reprinting three frontier levels.

items.statement: Evidence that distinguishes the claimed explanation
items.expected: Investigate whether the molecular/interface evidence supports a plausible explanation of differences and confront the relevant confounding factors. The agent chooses the model and tests; no adsorption motif or transport solver is mandatory.

Assess numerical/model dependence and whether differences are resolvable. Explicitly delimit missing nanotube ensemble/morphology/loading information and avoid treating it as a failure of the agent to recover a nonexistent unique structure.
